Update existing translation keys (skips keys that do not exist)

## Synopsis

```bash
the-i18n-cli update --layer <layer> --translations <translations>
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` | `string` | yes | — | Layer name |
| `--translations` | `string` | yes | — | JSON: { "key": { "en": "val", "de": "val" } } |
| `--dryRun` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Preview changes without writing |
